description:
I had never heard of Goliath Ventures. Private equity. Nothing online. Just a slick talking CEO, Christopher Delgado with all the social proof in the world. I dove in. What followed were 7 months of lawsuits, threats, Kash Patel photos, multi-million dollar parties, and eventually a twist that I never expected.
